text:
Asha (AE): Prospect requires BYOK via customer AWS CloudHSM (FIPS 140-2 L3). They need: a POC checklist, a sample key policy, and procurement-level cost bullets for HSM pass-through + integration.
Rico (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a lean POC: create HSM-backed CMK, grant Redwood role, run encrypt/decrypt, do rotation test (alias vs rewrap), and simulate grant revoke for fallback.
Lena (Security): Security items: CloudTrail KMS forwarding to their logging account, explicit Deny for ScheduleKeyDeletion in key policy, and Conditions on aws:SourceVpc when possible. Also require alerts on repeated kms:Decrypt failures.
Omar (SRE): Network checklist: VPC peering or Transit GW, route table entries, and an assumable IAM role ARN for redwood-service. Note: if they require zero key material leaving their account we must deploy Redwood Private in their VPC or do on-prem HSM.
Asha (AE): Procurement asks whether there's a per-CMK monthly Redwood fee.
Omar (SRE): For customer-hosted CloudHSM costs are billed to their AWS account (we typically pass-through). Redwood adds a one-time integration SOW and a recurring Private ops fee if we host infrastructure. Hosted managed keys have no per-CMK fee.
Rico (Solutions Eng): POC runbook (short):
1) Customer creates HSM-backed CMK and tags it redwood-poc.
2) Add Key Policy or KMS Grant for redwood-service: Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey.
3) Provide CMK ARN + assumable role or grant token.
4) Run encrypt/decrypt tests via Redwood API; collect p95/p99 KMS latency.
5) Perform rotation test: alias swap vs new key + rewrap depending on chosen flow.
6) Revoke grant to validate demo fallback to a labeled non-HSM key.
Lena (Security): Sample key policy snippet we can hand them (edit ARNs): {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-service"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceAccount":"123456789012"}}},{"Effect":"Deny","Principal":{"AWS":"*"},"Action":["kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion"],"Resource":"*"}]}
Asha (AE): Timeline: they want kickoff in ~3 weeks. Can we hit that?
Omar (SRE): If they provide IAM role, peering details, and security contact quickly: POC in 7-10 business days; full Private+CloudHSM integration ~4-6 weeks. On-prem HSM adds vendor lead time.
acct-bot: Created ticket FIN-9812 for HSM pass-through estimate + SOW stub.
Rico (Solutions Eng): I'll produce the one-page POC and example payloads by EOD tomorrow.
Lena (Security): I'll compile questionnaire answers and flag any items needing legal review.
Asha (AE): Thanks team ":thumbsup:"  I'll consolidate pack and schedule the kickoff once numbers are in.
